title: Pass event handlers down as props

slides.say: One Button component, but one should play a movie and another should upload an image. Let the parent decide.
Button takes an onClick prop and passes it straight to the browser button.
Each parent passes its own handler. The button holds the styling, the parent holds the behavior.

slides.text: Name your handler props on + Capital: onPlayMovie, onUploadImage.
slides.say: For your own components, you can name these props anything. By convention, start with on, then a capital letter, like on play movie.
